bundle.longDescription: saturnus tx moves files between HP 48SX, 48GX and 49G calculators on a serial cable (Kermit and XModem), emulated ones and the computer, and serves aplets to the 38G, 39G and 40G. To reach a serial port your user must be in the dialout group (uucp on Arch): sudo usermod -aG dialout $USER, then log in again. Not affiliated with HP; HP, HP48 and HP49 are trademarks of HP Inc.
